stem: What key idea is supported by the details in paragraphs 12 and 13?

options.label: F
options.text: People enjoy participating in efforts to track the monarchs.

options.label: G
options.text: Advanced technology is required to track migration paths of monarchs.

options.label: H
options.text: Monarch Watch uses photography as a main method of counting monarchs.

options.label: J
options.text: Young monarch watchers are often trained by older researchers.
